title: Kadavul Irukaan Kumaru
desc: Kumar and his friend decide to celebrate the former's bachelor's party before his wedding. However, chaos ensues when the duo are caught by the police for carrying alcohol.

title: Supreme
desc: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.

title: Vada Chennai
desc: A proficient carrom player sets foot in the world of crime and joins forces with local gangsters to settle their feuds. However, he decides to take them down when they plan to wipe out his locality.

title: Psycho
desc: A blind man, unable to prevent his lover's kidnapping by a psychopathic killer, becomes determined to rescue her from his deadly grasp.

title: Pechi
desc: Accompanied by a guide, five friends go on a trekking trip to a haunted forest and despite being warned, they enter a restricted area that harbours an evil spirit.

title: Kaariyavadhi
desc: A shrewd man runs a market to solely reap its profits. Soon, a young man falls in love with his daughter and stands against his authoritative rule.

title: Idhu Dhaanda Police
desc: Ramakrishnan, a police constable, is posted as a driver at Elathur women police station. He has to deal with the fiery sub-inspector, Arundhathi Varma, to save his job.

title: Ready
desc: Chandu, an engineering student, falls in love with Pooja, the girl he mistakenly abducts. However, before he can marry her, he must deal with two warring clans.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Burma
desc: Burma, a car thief, steals expensive cars. However, chaos ensues, when he is forced to race against time in order to acquire cars for a dreaded gangster.

title: Chandi Veeran
desc: Upon returning to his village, Paari strives to resolve the long-standing water conflict that claimed his father's life years ago.

title: Villain 2
desc: Ramu begins to look for his estranged brother, Rama, hoping to reunite him with their mother. However, he soon realises that his brother is now a part of a criminal organisation.

title: Sulthan
desc: Sultan, a motherless child, is raised by a group of criminals working for his father. However, when his father dies, he decides to reform the group into better people.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a teacher, tries to change the ongoing malpractices in a government school. Unfortunately, his acts are not welcomed by a few senior members and students, which leads to a rift between them.

title: Nela Ticket
desc: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.
